assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original refined CUT-PAPER COLLAGE illustration for a Grade 6 shared investigation about deciding what a repeated paper-bridge trial can tell us. Landscape 3:2, warm cream background, large simple flat scissor-cut shapes in teal, ochre, coral and muted navy, gently irregular handmade edges, subtle paper grain and tiny layered-paper shadows. Central scene: a single plain folded strip of teal paper spans a visible narrow gap between two equal ochre support blocks on a tabletop. Keep the paper bridge generic and modest; it represents an unspecified example, not either of two named designs or a construction guide. The bridge has NO load on it and is not bent or collapsing. Beside the setup, a shallow coral tray holds a few recognizable simple navy paper-clip shapes; no clip is on the bridge. An open cream notebook with blank pages and one pencil sits nearby, with two equal-size blank paper speech bubbles in teal and coral above it to suggest two investigation questions. No numeric data, no drawn charts, no ruler, no timer, no scientific apparatus beyond this simple setup. Keep all objects well inside the frame, readable at phone size, with clean space separating the gap, clip tray and notebook. The picture illustrates the situation; exact fictional loads, conditions, questions, and limitations will be supplied as editable caption text. Avoid implying any measured result or that a particular fold is stronger. No people, faces, readable words, letters, numbers, checkmarks, winner symbols, arrows, logos, watermarks, detailed textures, photographic realism, 3D rendering, or babyish decoration.
assets.editPrompt: Edit the provided illustration into a distinctly FLAT scissor-cut paper collage, preserving the same scene, palette, object count and relationships: one unloaded teal paper bridge spanning two ochre supports; three navy clips in a coral tray away from the bridge; blank open notebook, pencil, and two equally prominent blank speech bubbles. Make the supports simple flat ochre rectangles with just one tiny offset paper edge, remove deep cuboid side faces. Make the notebook, tray and pencil simplified overlapping 2D paper shapes with tiny layered-paper shadows only. Remove the realistic tabletop edge, receding perspective, realistic page curvature, cast shadows and diorama appearance. Warm cream background with flat tabletop shape; clear front-view composition. Keep the visible gap under the bridge, all clips off the bridge, and generous margins. No numbers, words, letters, symbols of success, arrows, people or new equipment. This is an original middle-school educational illustration, not a measured design or test result. Match the less-realistic flat cut-paper style of a classroom collage, with subtle paper grain and crisp simple shapes.
assets.alt: An unloaded teal paper bridge spans two ochre supports. Clips sit in a separate tray beside a blank notebook and two speech bubbles. The picture supplies no test result or design identity.
assets.credit: Original AI-generated cut-paper example; written record supplies all data and conditions; educator review pending
